Perform PCA

perform_pca.Rd

Computes a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the provided data matrix (samples as rows, features as columns), scaling and centering it beforehand. Useful for inspecting global structure and batch effects. Optionally saves a scree plot (eigenvalues/variance explained per component) to disk.

Usage

perform_pca(
  data,
  num_components = 30,
  save_eig_plot = FALSE,
  eig_ncp = 15,
  output_dir = NULL,
  plot_filename = "pca_eigenvalues.png"
)

Arguments

data

Matrix or dataframe. Samples as rows, features (e.g. genes) as columns.

num_components

Integer. Number of principal components to keep.

save_eig_plot

Logical. If TRUE, saves a scree plot of the first eig_ncp components via factoextra::fviz_eig(). Default FALSE.

eig_ncp

Integer. Number of components to show in the scree plot (passed to factoextra::fviz_eig(ncp = eig_ncp)). Default 15.

output_dir

Character. Directory where the scree plot is saved when save_eig_plot = TRUE. Created if it doesn't exist. Required in that case.

plot_filename

Character. File name for the saved scree plot. Default "pca_eigenvalues.png".

Value

A list containing pca_data (a dataframe with the retained principal components, samples as row names) and pca_summary (the summary.prcomp object, useful for inspecting variance explained per component).
